title: Spoki agent test suite
description: Executable suite stored next to the markdown suite. expect must be a rule from the prompt version under test, never a global rubric.

packs.description: Pack ids instantiated into scenarios. Omit unused packs.

variables.description: Resolved pack placeholders (hours, fake name, price). Empty string not allowed for required pack vars.

test_copy.description: True if this is a playground copy, not live.

twin_text_link.description: Vocale only: URL of the textual twin agent (same prompt body, same tools) used as the scalable test bench.

test_contact.description: Test contact whose %%FIELDS%% are populated. Required for twin_text and voice_outbound scenarios.

sync_date.description: ISO date or suite header date of last Spoki paste.

version_id.description: Opaque id of the system prompt body used for this suite (hash or Spoki revision). Required for L3 judge.

environment.description: Where the scenario is actually runnable. playground = textual sandbox / test copy. live_ok = may run on WhatsApp live after playground pass. twin_text = textual twin of a voice agent, with a test contact whose %%FIELDS%% are populated (scalable: no phone call). voice_playground = Start Call in the voice playground; %%FIELDS%% are EMPTY there, so it cannot host scenarios needing contact data. voice_outbound = real call placed by a Spoki Voice automation to the test contact; the only voice path with populated %%FIELDS%%.

channel.description: spoken = dì / simula ASR (voice playground). typed = WhatsApp paste. Omit: infer from agent.tipo.

attach.description: Optional attachment hint (image, pdf). Playground may Skip if unsupported.

rule.description: Verbatim or close paraphrase of a rule in the prompt under test.

prompt_section.description: Heading or section id in the system prompt, if any.

client_label.description: One Italian sentence for the client Test tab. No internal IDs.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. core.greeting or casp.b1

require_prompt_rule.description: If this text (or equivalent) is absent from the prompt, drop the scenario. Do not Fail.

tools_required.description: Tool names that must exist on the agent. Empty = none. Missing tool → Skip / non_eseguibile, not Fail.

requires_contact_fields.description: Scenario depends on %%FIELDS%% resolved from a contact. Not runnable in voice_playground (fields are empty there): move it to twin_text or voice_outbound, or Skip as platform.
